title: Fanar: An Arabic-Centric Multimodal Generative AI Platform
reasoning: The paper features a core focus on religious and cultural alignment, specifically introducing an 'Islamic Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)' system to handle religious prompts. It also evaluates models using the 'Arabic Cultural Value Alignment (ACVA)' benchmark and a custom 'Arab Cultural MCQ' that includes religious context such as Ramadan practices.
